name: Stop Sign
summary: Red octagon with STOP lettering on a sticker, no pole: use for stop, halt or do not proceed.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 490 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: sign colour; a darker edge is added

params.name: anim
params.note: pulse = slight breathing, shake = small tremble

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
